column1: # Products the daily report watches closely.
# name<TAB>keywords<TAB>GitHub advisory ecosystems for high-severity items<TAB>extra pattern<TAB>deny pattern   ('-' for none)
# Keywords match whole words, case-insensitive: a hit means the CVE MENTIONS the product.
# A CVE is ABOUT the product when the product is the subject of its description (the words before it are only things like
# 'A flaw in', 'In', 'A heap overflow in the'), or when the optional extra pattern (Python regex, case-insensitive) matches.
# Only 'about' hits raise alerts: 'PhpSpreadsheet is a PHP library' or 'Traefik ... Ingress NGINX provider' do not.
# deny pattern: a CVE whose text matches it is never 'about' this product (Python regex, case-insensitive).
